faqs.q: What type of businesses require a business license?
faqs.a: All businesses located within the City are required to obtain a business license and file a tax return based on their filing frequency. Any business coming into the City to sell, lease, rent, deliver, or install tangible personal property is also required to be licensed. Non-profit organizations should have a business license but no tax returns will be required.
